description: This file defines the DashboardLayout component and associated subcomponents TopNav and SideNav for a React application. It constructs the main layout for dashboard pages, including navigation and header controls.

methods.name: DashboardLayout
methods.description: Main layout component providing structure with top navigation, side navigation, and nested route content.

methods.name: TopNav
methods.description: Component rendering the top navigation bar with brand link, navigation links, and auth controls.

methods.name: SideNav
methods.description: Component rendering the side navigation menu with links to dashboard-related pages.
